name: Thotsamarachan Bridge
connectingPointsDisplay: Foot of Rama IX Bridge (Thonburi side) — Bang Khlo Interchange (Bang Phongphang, Yannawa District)
facts: Thotsamarachan Bridge, the first double‑pylon cable‑stayed bridge in Thailand, spans 781.20 meters with a 450‑meter central span, matching Rama IX Bridge’s length while adding eight lanes for 150,000 daily vehicles.
Engineered by Epsilon Co., Ltd., the bridge’s pylons rise 87 meters and its deck sits 10 meters above ground, enabling smoother traffic flow and reducing congestion that plagued Rama IX Bridge.
After rigorous wind‑load simulations, the bridge can withstand speeds up to 270 km/h—tornado‑level winds—ensuring resilience against storms, earthquakes, and extreme weather.
